# MCAT image credits

The 20 amino-acid structural formula images in this folder were retrieved from
the NIH National Library of Medicine PubChem PUG REST service. PubChem is a
United States government scientific resource. Each image represents the
two-dimensional structure record for the named L-amino acid (glycine is
achiral). Source: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/

The MCAT cards also reuse the separately credited open-license diagrams in
`../science-diagrams/CREDITS.md` and formula figures already distributed with
the AP Chemistry deck.
